sequences.name: Scribe

main_ingredients: Cursed artifacts of an ancient wraith
supplementary_ingredients: 30 milliliters of Seawater, Lake Water, Glacier Water each

sequences.acting_method: Record various Beyonder abilities. Record local customs and folklore in different places. There are many things in the world that we have yet to understand… This is what a Scribe should record.
sequences.consumption_backlash: Their brain would rapidly start expanding. The grand folds and white matter rapidly increased as their body gradually blurred, separating into individual cells. Those cells would form a haloed 'door' that circled their brain. They would then hear ravings. But wouldn't significantly affect them in any way. The ravings would include Mr Door's. Especially for those that inherited the lineage of the Abraham Family. If an Abraham Family member this were during the full moon, they would certainly lose control immediately. After an unknown period of time, they would finally regain control over their brain and cells and could sense their body's existence. Almost at the same time, a large amount of knowledge would resonate in their mind, making them understand how to use the powers of a Scribe. The mutated 'brain' reproduced the Beyonder powers used by the target before driving a portion of the vitalized cells to form corresponding symbols, patterns, and labels for complete storage. This was 'I came, I saw, I record,' which used one's soul as a pen and one's Spirit Body as the paper.

sequences.name: Traveler
sequences.potion_overview: Whitish yet transparent, resembling half-melted snowwater with occasional light green bubbles.

main_ingredients: Heart of a Shadowless Demonic Wolf
supplementary_ingredients: 10 grams of Trapped Ghost Residue Powder
1 Star Chart Drawn with Spirit Blood
80 milliliters of Shadowless Demonic Wolf's Blood

sequences.advancement_ritual: Set up special coordinates in four completely different spots deep in the Spirit World which are all set up extremely far away from each other.
sequences.ritual_essence: The four special coordinates aren't only used to help them find a way back after getting flung into the Spirit World, they can also effectively maintain their self-awareness.
sequences.consumption_backlash: In the blink of an eye, they would feel their body and eyes light up one after another. They would blast around their body and open one illusory door after another. Their consciousness wouldn't be able to help but enter one of them. Their entire body would turn transparent and vanish. In such a chaotic state of mind, they nearly couldn't regain their sense of self-awareness. They could feel the four special coordinates in the Spirit World from time to time, helping them maintain their self-awareness. Finally, they would slowly come to their senses. After an unknown period of time, they would realise that they had already entered the depths of the Spirit World. It was difficult to tell her exact location, and she couldn't find her 'way' back. With the help of the four special coordinates, they can slowly 'traverse' back to a familiar spot, leaving the saturated, stacked colors and the thin fog before walking out of the Spirit World.

sequences.name: Secrets Sorcerer
sequences.potion_overview: Rippling with starlight, as if containing a miniature galaxy. The potion is like icy water that could hurt someone due to the extreme temperature.

main_ingredients: Eye of a Golden Phoenix OR Siskun Demon Worm Leader
Ankh Gate's Foundation (Ankh Gate is a door with spirituality and a certain degree of intelligence)
supplementary_ingredients: Choose one of: Siskun Demon Worm's Nest, Ankh Gate's Ashes, or Golden Phoenix's Feather
100 milliliters of Lake Water Freshly Reflecting the Cosmos

sequences.advancement_ritual: Seal a creature of demigod level, the creature must be hostile toward you, lesser outside help used, better will the ritual's result.
sequences.consumption_backlash: All of their senses vanish in the areas that the potion passed, leaving only them with only still thoughts. It is inevitable that a person would hallucinate in extreme cold temperatures. In their vision, a night sky instantly appeared. It was dotted with countless stars that weaved together to form a dream-like river. Their body would begin reflecting bits of stellar radiance as if they came from their own body. The tiny bits of pure stellar radiance forms an invisible connection with the different stars in the night sky. As the light shimmered, they twisted and squirmed as insect-like creatures crawled out of their body. They want to seek refuge in the Milky Way formed by an array of embedded diamond shards. Each of them carried a portion of their own flesh and consciousness, as though they were uncontrollable avatars. Their thinking quickly turns chaotic, and they would fall into confusion. They almost couldn't control the urge to separate themself. At that moment, they would sense an illusory object. It is the seal that they had completed. It is being projected into the mysterious world created by the potion, forming an abstract, blurry mark. They wouldn't think any further as they instinctively extend a portion of their consciousness along with their spirituality, and intertwine with the abstract symbol. The mark wasn't exactly harmonious with them, as if it wasn't part of them, but it manages to barely merge with them. Suddenly, in their mind, the abstract symbol would become rather clear. It consists of a 'door' that is layered with mysterious symbols. This door hid them behind it, allowing them to isolate themself from the surrounding cosmos. At the same time, on the other side of the 'door,' the sealed creature seems to sense the aura of an enemy. Using its own godhood, it wildly corroded the illusory door. It happens to be able to reduce the influence the cosmos had on them. After maintaining it for more than ten seconds, the resplendent Milky Way's night sky slowly fades away. The stellar radiance then returned to their body fused with them. For those who are affected by Bethel Abraham: A deep darkness would appear in front of them. Deep in the darkness was a perpetual storm and occasionally flashing lightning. The next second, they hear a familiar voice. It stabbed into their head like steel nails stirring their brain matter. If they hadn't experienced such things over and over in the past, and had some level of resistance, as well as the fact that they are at the saint level, they would have likely lost control. It is a calling for help. It wasn't Jotun, Elvish or Ancient Hermes. Instead, it is a language that they may have never come into contact with before. However, they could understand it the moment they heard it. They would feel like it is the true source of many languages. A wispy voice that could pierce through Spirit Bodies would then enter their mind. They could proceed to have a normal conversation.
